usage.source_scope: All six consumed PB4 test frames with a correct same-frame SCIL proof: three glass-portal positives, two no-portal negative controls, and one open architectural entrance outside the frozen paired-handle representation.
usage.project_application: Test whether separately proved place identity can authorize a retained portal set without wrong-request, no-portal, OOD, UNKNOWN, or COMMIT leakage.
usage.modifications: Add a typed entity authority token and a truth-blind paired-handle opportunity predicate frozen from the previous six-frame source-disjoint positive portal result. Run the unchanged proposer on every proof-positive frame; audit labels cannot gate execution.
usage.expected_effect: Retain at least 2/3 correct portal sets while authorizing neither no-portal controls nor the representation-OOD aperture and preserving zero wrong-request and UNKNOWN leakage.

evaluation.setup: The PB5 source audit froze all six SCIL-proof-positive rows before any portal proposer call on these frames. The opportunity predicate came only from the prior six positive fresh portal frames. One mechanical launch failed before proposer execution; the output-bearing run used refrozen hashes and made zero new OCR or embedding calls.
evaluation.effect: Raw proposer truth retention was 2/3 at both top one and top three, but only 1/3 positives retained an authorized truth member. One of two no-portal controls falsely authorized a portal. The OOD aperture, all 18 wrong-request pairs, both identity-UNKNOWN rows, and every COMMIT/navigation state remained blocked. The joined geometry-only authorization gate is rejected rather than rescued by tuning.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Consumed-identity/current-image Development composition evidence on a curated opportunity cohort. It rejects only the frozen geometry authorization layer. Wrong requests are source-label proxies. No portal ownership, access, traversability, active view, guidance, arrival, product, user, or safety claim follows.

evidence.summary: Frozen PB5 source, independent structural opportunity predicate, truth-blind execution contract, controls, and stop rule.
Durable PB5 metrics, failed gates, diagnosis, hashes, forbidden rescue, and successor.
Per-frame proposals, structural admission, truth membership, authority tokens, controls, metrics, and gate clauses.

history.change: Executed PB5 once after source and opportunity-gate freeze. Rejected geometry-only portal authorization after positive coverage and no-portal specificity both failed; closed threshold and geometry tuning on this cohort.
